shots.visual_action: blue cracks pulse in the iron chamber as dawn light enters through a high porthole; Mira keeps her body between the child and the restraint machine
shots.dialogue: ROOK OFFSCREEN: Dawn test in one hour.
shots.sound_design: hull groan, distant winch, restrained breathing
shots.director_note: deadline enters as light, not exposition

shots.visual_action: outside the chamber Tam aligns the copied key with a service lock while a patrol lantern passes over his hand
shots.dialogue: none
shots.sound_design: tiny metal click, lantern hum, held breath
shots.director_note: betrayal image converts into active infiltration

shots.visual_action: Mira sees Tam through the bars and deliberately shifts the child behind her rather than reaching for rescue
shots.dialogue: MIRA: If this is another road you sold us, stop now.
shots.sound_design: voice close, chain slack
shots.director_note: trust repair begins as boundary, not forgiveness

shots.visual_action: Tam opens his sleeve to show fresh lash marks and a navy route map sewn into the cloth
shots.dialogue: TAM: I led them away from the boats. Then I came back.
shots.sound_design: paper friction, distant boots
shots.director_note: evidence complicates apparent betrayal

shots.visual_action: the child looks from Mira's scarred hand to Tam's key, then taps the lock side of the bars with one claw
shots.dialogue: none
shots.sound_design: claw tap, glass scale chime
shots.director_note: the vulnerable character participates in the trust decision

shots.visual_action: Tam opens the service door; Mira does not run for the exit but turns toward rows of covered creature cages
shots.dialogue: TAM: Exit is the other way.
shots.sound_design: door hydraulic hiss, muffled animal movement
shots.director_note: escape direction becomes moral choice

shots.visual_action: Mira pulls canvas from cages containing young sea creatures with scarred harnesses and extinguished scale-light
shots.dialogue: MIRA: We do not leave the others in the dark. Protection is not control.
shots.sound_design: canvas drag, weak creature cries, music withheld
shots.director_note: agency broadens protection beyond one child

shots.visual_action: Tam cuts harness buckles while Mira calms creatures one by one; the child presses its forehead to each cage before opening
shots.dialogue: none
shots.sound_design: buckles snapping, breathing, soft scale chimes
shots.director_note: coordinated found-family labor

shots.visual_action: a patrol enters; instead of scattering, the freed creatures dim their lights together and hide the group in darkness
shots.dialogue: none
shots.sound_design: boots pass, water drips, near-silence
shots.director_note: care creates capability reversal

shots.visual_action: Mira starts the three-note lullaby but cannot finish the third note; the child answers with a broken fourth tone
shots.dialogue: MIRA humming brokenly: mm-mm—
shots.sound_design: voice tremor, answering creature tone
shots.director_note: sound motif exposes wounded trust

shots.visual_action: the group enters a storm-lit ship canal where freed creatures move beneath black water carrying fragments of glowing memory-scales
shots.dialogue: none
shots.sound_design: water displacement, distant thunder, low hull rhythm
shots.director_note: multi-creature escape setpiece begins

shots.visual_action: scale fragments show flashes of Rook ordering the nursery fire and then sink into the mouths of courier-like fish
shots.dialogue: TAM: They remember routes better than we do.
shots.sound_design: muffled water, memory chime
shots.director_note: proof becomes mobile and distributable

shots.visual_action: navy lamps sweep the canal; Mira chooses the narrower creature culvert instead of the open human exit
shots.dialogue: MIRA: If they can pass, we pass smaller.
shots.sound_design: alarm bell, water rush, rope snap
shots.director_note: Mira adapts rather than dominating creatures

shots.visual_action: a falling gate separates Tam from Mira; he throws the copied key through the gap and stays behind to jam the mechanism
shots.dialogue: TAM: You do not have to forgive me. Just do not waste it.
shots.sound_design: metal impact, gate grind, key skid
shots.director_note: costly action earns trust more than apology

shots.visual_action: the child dives after a dropped memory-scale; its fear light flares, then steadies when Mira's hand appears beside it rather than grabbing it
shots.dialogue: none
shots.sound_design: underwater pressure, heartbeat, muted glass ping
shots.director_note: protection respects agency under panic

shots.visual_action: creatures surface beyond the naval cordon and scatter toward the capital carrying the memory-proof; Tam rejoins soaked and bleeding
shots.dialogue: MIRA: We are not even. But trust can move before forgiveness.
shots.sound_design: rain, wings/fins dispersal, exhausted breath
shots.director_note: fragile trust and mission forward

shots.visual_action: beneath the capital the child freezes; a vast mother-call vibrates through the storm vault walls and every scale answers blue
shots.dialogue: none
shots.sound_design: deep sub-bass call, answering scale chorus, sudden silence
shots.director_note: retention hook: the child may not be the last

shots.visual_action: the first channel-test pulse travels through the water and starts closing a stormglass gate ahead of the escaping creatures
shots.dialogue: ROOK DISTANT: Begin the channel test.
shots.sound_design: deep pulse, gate grind, fleet bell layering
shots.director_note: public weaponization countdown directly endangers the escape

shots.visual_action: a guard's whip arcs toward the child; Tam takes the blow across his back without using the child as a shield
shots.dialogue: TAM: Not forgiveness. Proof.
shots.sound_design: whip impact, breath shock, music drops out
shots.director_note: trust is repaired through cost, not apology

shots.visual_action: freed creatures stream through the storm-lit canal carrying memory-scales toward separate capital witnesses while the child's scales answer the distant mother-call
shots.dialogue: MIRA: Go. Carry what they tried to burn.
shots.sound_design: water rush, memory chimes, mother-call undertone
shots.director_note: proof, creatures, and family mystery move together

shots.visual_action: dawn breaks over the canal as Rook's fleet bells begin the weaponization test; Mira, Tam, and the child turn toward the capital instead of safety
shots.dialogue: ROOK DISTANT: Open the channel.
shots.sound_design: fleet bells, distant thunder, lullaby fragment harmonizing with mother-call
shots.director_note: exit on deeper family mystery plus public countdown
